# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser game titled "Conference Room Cold Open" from this prompt: Workplace cringe comedy. A satirical game inspired by The Office with awkward social mini-games, deadpan documentary humor, office politics, lovable incompetence, cringe timing, and mundane-chaos meme energy with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The game is a branching two-choice narrative survival comedy. The player is a lovable but unreliable office employee in a mockumentary workplace. Each scene reveals typed text, then two large mobile-friendly choices. Choices adjust two 0-100 meters: Composure and Credibility. Negative choices shake the scene and spawn red particles; positive choices play a lighter tone and spawn green particles. If either meter reaches zero, the run ends in a themed failure. Otherwise the story progresses through office social mini-games until a final ending. Use a procedural office background with paper grids, cubicle shadows, sticky-note shapes, documentary recording badge, memo-paper panels, and bold comic display typography. Preserve the simple choice mechanics and restart flow exactly.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first branching narrative choice game with animated canvas ambience and stat meters
- objective: guide an office worker through a workday by selecting one of two choices at each story node until an ending is reached
- input model: tap/click start, tap/click one of two large choice buttons, tap/click restart after an ending
- core loop: start screen -> typed story text -> reveal two choices -> apply health/mood deltas -> update meters and feedback -> transition to the next node -> ending or stat-depletion failure
- fail/friction state: health/mood can drop to zero and trigger burnout/drained endings; explicit branches can also end the run

## Protected mechanics
- Two-choice branching node structure, delayed text typing, and delayed transition after a choice are preserved.
- Two clamped 0-100 stat bars are preserved; only their vocabulary changed from Energy/Mood to Composure/Credibility.
- Positive/negative feedback, particles, body shake, start/restart state flow, and explicit ending screens are preserved.
- Touch/click semantics remain native and large enough for portrait mobile play.

## Remixed target
Conference Room Cold Open reframes the same choice-survival mechanics as a deadpan documentary office comedy. The focal actor is a lovable-incompetent office employee being observed by a hidden crew. Hazards are awkward silence, office politics, printers, birthday rituals, gossip, and mandatory fun. Rewards are credibility, composure, and surviving with a usable freeze-frame. The public surface is rebuilt as a single inline HTML/CSS/JS game with procedural office background, documentary camera UI, memo-paper panels, mobile portrait hierarchy, and catalog-backed fonts.
